option_relations.rationale: Carcinoma en cuirasse is a form of cutaneous metastasis, which is a subtype of cutaneous metastasis.
Carcinoma en cuirasse (cutaneous lymphatic metastasis) is explicitly stated as a form of cutaneous metastasis.

Inflammatory breast cancer is a primary breast cancer type, not a cutaneous metastasis, although it can present with skin changes. The biopsy findings of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels point to metastasis, not primary inflammatory breast cancer.
Carcinoma erysipelatoides is a rare form of cutaneous metastasis, thus a subtype of cutaneous metastasis.
